stumbles.quote: thick film sinks toward the tilt
stumbles.why: Unclear what "the tilt" is: a tilt of the device or the film, in which direction, and whether the user controls it. It is never introduced.

stumbles.quote: black film spreads from the top
stumbles.why: "Black film" is not explained. A reader may not know it means the very thin film just before a soap bubble pops. It also reads oddly after thin film is said to rise.
The text never says the piece is meant for phones or mobile. The tilt may imply device sensors, but that link is not stated.
The date is odd status information. It is unclear whether it marks a version I should care about.

point: A WebGPU compute-shader soap film simulation where thickness drives flow, drainage and popping, tested only on a software GPU and not yet on real phone hardware.
